findings.description: The functions process_user and process_admin contain identical implementation logic, leading to unnecessary code duplication.
Code duplication detected: process_user and process_admin perform identical logic for data sanitization, violating the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle.

reasons: The candidate successfully refactored the code to use a single normalization function, effectively resolving the identified code duplication issues.
The implementation is clean, readable, and maintains the original behavior as confirmed by the passing test suite.
No security vulnerabilities were introduced; the use of str() and strip().lower() is safe for the intended purpose.
The maintainability score is high because the code adheres to the DRY principle and is well-structured.
